description:
You are a trauma radiologist reviewing a cranial CT scan to document intracranial air (pneumocephalus) and paranasal sinus air space distribution following head trauma. The CT Cranium DICOM series is already loaded in InVesalius 3. A radiology request form is at /home/ga/Documents/air_analysis/radiology_request.txt.

Create a complete pneumocephalus documentation package:
1. Create a segmentation mask for intracranial and sinus air spaces using a Hounsfield threshold range that captures air. Air is approximately -1024 to -200 HU — your air mask maximum threshold must be at or below -200 HU to exclude soft tissue.
2. Generate a 3D surface mesh from the air space mask.
3. Export the air space surface as an STL file to /home/ga/Documents/air_analysis/air_spaces.stl
4. Create a second segmentation mask for brain soft tissue (Hounsfield range that includes values near 0 HU, specifically the maximum must be >= 50 HU and the minimum must be >= -200 HU, e.g. approximately -100 to 80 HU for brain parenchyma).
5. Place at least 4 linear measurements documenting the extent of major air pockets or sinus cavity dimensions in the slice views.
6. Save the complete InVesalius project (with both masks and all measurements) to /home/ga/Documents/air_analysis/pneumocephalus_study.inv3
